negative_reviews.author: Snoopy
negative_reviews.text:
Chilled atmosphere
Attentive friendly staff welcoming
Nice interior
Food was good although not the best tasting chicken karrage ramen not quite enough flavour but perhaps just not the best menu option !
Tiger roll was nice although had a belly ache after eating

negative_reviews.author: Paul Fisher
negative_reviews.text:
It was going to be a more positive review until.......
Sat gown after thr waiter banged thr drum (happens each time people enter) took my order the prawns and squid were on but a tad greasy. The prawns were borderline cooked.
Sadly the Kimchi arrived after I had finished my mains so rejected it.
Was planning to order Mochi but not after thr failures.

negative_reviews.author: Shazina Jussab
negative_reviews.text:
We visited Maki & Ramen today, really excited to try it as our children love noodles and ramen. Unfortunately, the experience was awful.

The food was below mediocre and lacked flavour, just full of soya sauce, while the service was extremely slow and our orders were repeatedly incorrect. My son’s meal arrived after everyone else had finished eating, and we had to separate the children’s meals ourselves.

Several items we ordered were only declared out of stock after we had waited several minutes, leaving us to choose alternatives. This was particularly strange given that we visited at 1 pm during half term. We should have been informed upfront rather than left waiting.

My daughter’s meal was unbearably salty, and the menu and online ordering system were confusing. We don’t mind paying premium prices for good food, but neither the food nor the service justified the cost.
Overall, a terrible experience and certainly won't be going back.
